notes: From-anywhere setup no longer gets stuck. The Add your iPhone step shows a QR code to scan, since the old button opened the App Store on your computer where the phone app cannot be installed. If Tailscale's status can't be read, setup now says so and lets you continue instead of waiting forever on a step you already did. Status messages line up properly when they wrap. The macOS build is Apple Silicon only (M1 or newer).
